note: Curated by the Bharat Sourcer team from docs/04-reference/02-india-sellers-and-apis.md and docs/02-architecture/06-sourcing-and-seller-data.md (seed sellers, research of October 2026). Not provided or confirmed by the sellers. 'established' marks seed sellers whose trust was reviewed by the team; platform is the research note, informational only ('unknown' means not confirmed). 'search' configures direct catalogue search (seller_search.py); 'enabled' turns it on; 'robots' records a manual robots.txt review (one request with the BharatSourcer user agent) and the date. The fetcher re-checks robots.txt before every request regardless. Review periodically.

robots.finding: Shopify robots.txt; /search and /search/suggest.json not disallowed for *. File asks agents to use UCP/MCP for catalogue, cart and checkout; checkout automation forbidden (we never check out).
WordPress robots.txt; /wp-json/ not disallowed (cart, checkout, account, tags and filter/orderby queries are).
Redirects to www.rytronics.in; WooCommerce default robots.txt; /wp-json/ not disallowed.
robots.txt has groups for Googlebot/Adsbot only (empty Disallow); no * group, so nothing is disallowed for other agents.
BigCommerce robots.txt disallows /search.php for *; product pages are allowed (no crawl-delay for *). Named AI crawlers get Crawl-delay: 10.
Magento robots.txt disallows /catalogsearch/result/, /search/ and every query string (/*?*) for *; product .html pages are allowed.
OpenCart robots.txt (www.electronicscomp.com) disallows /*?route=product/search for *; product pages are allowed.
OpenCart robots.txt (www.flyrobo.in) disallows /*?route=product/search and /*?keyword for *; Crawl-delay: 1.

robots.txt disallows /api/ except /api/proxy/graphql for * (its comment: product and category pages fetch their data client-side through it). HTML pages answer a Cloudflare challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge), so only the GraphQL proxy is read: productSearch for search, productdetails for product pages (robu.py). /api/search/ is disallowed and not used. Challenges are not circumvented.
